title: Hollow Knight Silksong Needle Spears
description: A resource pack that changes your spear to look like the needle from Hollow Knight Silksong when you rename it to "Needle".
body:
A resource pack that changes spears into the Silksong needles. To get your spear to become a needle, rename it to "Needle". The different tiers of needle are obtainable with different levels of sharpness, with each level of sharpness tiering your needle up by one place. Needle is the base needle and Pale Steel Needle takes up both sharpness 4 and 5.

My other Hollow Knight related packs:
- [Hollow Knight Nail Swords](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hollow-knight-nail-swords)
